import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv')

# Create a visualization showing sleep duration distribution by BMI category
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
barplot = sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, ci='sd', capsize=0.2)
sns.swarmplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, color=".2", size=8)

# Add individual data points as swarmplot on top of barplot
for i in range(3):
    barplot.containers[i].set_facecolor('lightblue')

plt.title('Sleep Duration by BMI Category\n(With Individual Data Points)', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
